rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 11 "See the mechanism repeat in every phase": line 97: "the colleague-guide frame" is the closest call (Phase 2 names it "colleague-help section"); it sits in a **What happened:** recap, session-artifact carve-out applies, and "StoryBrand" + "colleague" are named on chunks 3-4. Line 35 "StoryBrand shapes only the colleague-help section" resolves to line 29. No bare pronoun lacks an antecedent.

line 105: "the [Cookbook for Agent System Design](../trainings/...)" names its target by title; line 105 "Recipe 1" resolves (cookbook has a Recipe catalogue, 8 recipes). No "the opening lecture"/"module X said" pointers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 103: "between Phase 1 and Phase 6" and line 71 "module-1/context-trace.md" resolve to chunk 1 / chunk 9 and the Phase 5 prompt; line 97 "the site it wrote last" is a session artifact. No "the X you did/caught" with a missing beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 67: "Run this one. The debrief starts from the file it writes, and the agent waits for one answer from you." closest to a muted-read cue, but "this one" binds to the prompt on the same slide and the setup is verbed; no guess/predict instruction anywhere (grep guess|predict in body: none).

chunk 2 "Phase 2: Apply a framework you know" (lines 21-25) is the thinnest: one self-carrying claim at line 25 ("The site isn't there to sell. A colleague who visits it should think ..."), not a wait-state.
chunk 11 line 93 header "See the mechanism repeat in every phase" vs line 97 body naming each phase's context (LinkedIn, frame, strengths, mirror-list): body supports the header.

line 103: "The LLM didn't get better between Phase 1 and Phase 6. The context did." is a two-part contrast, not "Not X. Not Y. Z."; no triple anaphora, no self-grading superlative (grep "most useful|best|powerful" none), no number-plus-retraction.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: lines 29, 33, 39 use "beats" (Stakes, Call-to-Action; "run the beats"; "five tuned beats"): StoryBrand framework vocabulary the student meets in the prompt, ordinary story-structure usage, communicating not displaying. Closest to firing; no "surface/compendium/forcing function/mood/firing" in body (grep 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 "Phase 1: The boring baseline": line 15: "**Drop your LinkedIn text into the prompt below, after the colon. Send as one message.**" and line 13 "**Open your own LinkedIn profile in your browser.**" bold whole lead sentences (monoculture shape, 3 bolded leads on one slide); chunk 3 "Name the framework and tune it": line 31 "**Name the framework, tune it, have the agent run it.**" bolded sentence plus line 29 "**StoryBrand**" = 2; chunk 6 "Phase 4": line 53 "**Invert the easy thing.**" plus line 55 "**Name the framework, tune it, ask the agent to run it.**" = 2, line 55 is an orphan bold sentence. Harm (bold stops marking handles, slides read as menus) present: a whole-sentence bold is not a handle. No accept-note, no §34 or LO-template exception applies. Non-blocking polish.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Bold the handle only: 'Open' step names, 'Send as one message'; keep one bold per slide (the repeated name-tune-run line is the handle on chunk 3, plain on chunk 6).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file → slides: 12; grep "^## " body = 12 headings (lines 9,21,27,33,41,49,57,63,75,83,93,99); every `##` is under the exercise wrapper so all 12 reach the deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/exercises/personal-site-with-guardrails.md → "OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent." Phases 1-7 consecutive; refs at line 103 "Phase 1"/"Phase 6" resolve.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file ... → "OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut." Line 15 "the prompt below" has its paste block in the same chunk (line 17).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: one in-body link, line 105 "[Cookbook for Agent System Design](...)": names the document in link text so the sentence works stripped; no geometry location. Review surface, never a gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... → "slides: 12 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets oversized: 0 ✓ every slide is within limits".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: exercise `##` headings are phase labels (lines 9, 21, 41, 49, 63, 75, 83) or imperatives ("Name the framework and tune it" 27, "Keep yourself the protagonist, then run the beats" 33, "List what you hate, then invert it" 57, "See the mechanism repeat in every phase" 93, "Take the context move past this site" 99); none is a mis-voiced declarative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 103: "The LLM didn't get better between Phase 1 and Phase 6. The context did." sits under **The point:** and is that line itself, not a kicker restating a header; line 73 "LLMs go easy on their own output." gives the reason for the over-flag move (adds an object). No doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git diff 4d9c4af2..HEAD -- file | grep -E "^[-+]##" → no output: no `##` header changed since the pin, so no retitled slide to re-earn.
